info.title: LFX V2 - Voting Service
info.description: Proxy service for ITX voting system

post.description:
Submit a vote response (proxies to ITX POST /voting/vote)

**Required security scopes for jwt**:
  * `manage:projects`
  * `manage:voting`

get.description:
Get vote response details (proxies to ITX GET /voting/vote/{vote_id})

**Required security scopes for jwt**:
  * `manage:projects`
  * `manage:voting`

put.description:
Update vote response (proxies to ITX PUT /voting/vote/{vote_id})

**Required security scopes for jwt**:
  * `manage:projects`
  * `manage:voting`

post.description:
Resend vote email (proxies to ITX POST /voting/vote/{vote_id}/resend)

**Required security scopes for jwt**:
  * `manage:projects`
  * `manage:voting`

Create a new vote (proxies to ITX POST /voting/poll)

**Required security scopes for jwt**:
  * `manage:projects`
  * `manage:voting`

get.description:
Get vote details (proxies to ITX GET /voting/poll/{poll_id})

**Required security scopes for jwt**:
  * `manage:projects`
  * `manage:voting`

put.description:
Update vote (proxies to ITX PUT /voting/poll/{poll_id}). Only allowed when status is 'disabled'

**Required security scopes for jwt**:
  * `manage:projects`
  * `manage:voting`

delete.description:
Delete vote (proxies to ITX DELETE /voting/poll/{poll_id}). Only allowed when status is 'disabled'

**Required security scopes for jwt**:
  * `manage:projects`
  * `manage:voting`

post.description:
Bulk resend vote email to select recipients (proxies to ITX POST /voting/poll/{poll_id}/bulk_resend)

**Required security scopes for jwt**:
  * `manage:projects`
  * `manage:voting`

put.description:
Enable a vote for voting (proxies to ITX PUT /voting/poll/{poll_id}/enable)

**Required security scopes for jwt**:
  * `manage:projects`
  * `manage:voting`

post.description:
End an active vote immediately (proxies to ITX POST /voting/poll/{poll_id}/end). Idempotent for an already-ended vote; a disabled vote returns 409.

**Required security scopes for jwt**:
  * `manage:projects`
  * `manage:voting`

Extend a vote's end time (proxies to ITX POST /voting/poll/{poll_id}/extend)

**Required security scopes for jwt**:
  * `manage:projects`
  * `manage:voting`

get.description:
Get vote results (proxies to ITX GET /voting/poll/{poll_id}/results)

**Required security scopes for jwt**:
  * `manage:projects`
  * `manage:voting`
